title: Atomic Chat Foundry Local model list
description: Models of the `foundry-local` provider, plus where the app finds the rest. The app resolves a variant through `resolver` (an undocumented Azure ML registry endpoint that answers without an account with a short-lived SAS link to the variant's blob container), downloads every listed file into <data>/foundry-local/models/<variant id>/<path>, checking size and sha256, and writes model.yml last. Models of the live Microsoft catalog at `catalog.url` are shown after the curated ones, checked by size only; a curated variant with the same asset id and version wins. The app skips a variant whose `source.kind`, execution provider or device it does not know, and a model left with no variants, so new kinds of source are added next to the old ones.

url_template.description: Resolve URL. The app substitutes {region} and the URL-encoded {asset_id} and reads `blobSasUri` (the container link) from the answer.

regions.description: Azure regions tried in order until one answers.

url.description: Microsoft model catalog (asset-gallery) the app queries for Foundry Local chat models beyond this list.

models.description: Curated models, shown first in the order listed. May be empty: the Hub then shows the Microsoft catalog only.

path.description: Relative path without '.' or '..' segments (the integrity check enforces the latter).

context_length.description: Largest context of the model's variants (kvTags.contextLength). A variant with a smaller one says so itself.

id.description: Unique across the list: names the download task and the folder <data>/foundry-local/models/<id>.

execution_provider.description: Passed to Foundry Local explicitly when the model is registered.

context_length.description: Present only when this variant's context is smaller than the model's (NPU builds are compiled for a short one). The app uses it instead of the model's.

asset_id.description: Full Azure ML asset id, version included, exactly as the catalog spells it.

path_prefix.description: Folder inside the container (kvTags.directoryPath). File URLs are <container>/<path_prefix>/<path>.

path.description: Relative to path_prefix in the container and to the variant folder on disk.
